Data Design Developer 
 Req number: 
R8759 
 Employment type: 
Full time 
 Worksite flexibility: 
Onsite 
 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
As a Data Design Developer, you will design and implement data architecture and schemas and support enterprise data integrations for our client’s notification platform on Microsoft Azure and Power Platform. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a Data Design Developer to design and implement data architecture and schemas and support enterprise data integrations for our client’s notification platform on Microsoft Azure and Power Platform. This position will be full-time contract and hybrid with 2-days onsite. Candidates may work from Hyattsville, MD; Washington, DC; or Alexandria, VA. 
   
 Only candidates not requiring sponsorship now or in the future will be considered. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Design and implement data architecture and schemas supporting the notification platform
 Support enterprise data integrations across Microsoft Azure and Power Platform environments
 Become proficient in our client’s data platforms and develop familiarity with application data structures and schemas
 Analyze business needs and advise on enhancements to existing solutions and the design of new data structures and schemas
 Implement enterprise data architectures for production applications and adapt existing architectures as needed
 Support enhancement, optimization, and enterprise integration of public-facing notification platforms
 Participate in application development supporting new business processes and operational improvements
 Refine and automate existing business processes
 Develop and support enterprise system integrations
 Contribute to UX/UI improvements and accessibility enhancements
 Support quality assurance, performance optimization, and scalable solution development
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams using Agile methodology
 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and/or a combination of education, certification, and experience that provides an equivalent level of competency
 8 years of experience in the field or a related area
 5 to 7 years of hands-on experience
 Experience with relational SQL and NoSQL database design
 Experience with document modeling and denormalized data structures
 Experience with Azure SQL Database and SQL Managed Instance
 Experience with Azure Blob Storage
 Experience with Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB
 Experience supporting BI reporting data layers
 Experience designing, deploying, enhancing, and supporting highly available mission-critical applications
 Knowledge of enterprise governance frameworks, security practices, and delivery methodologies
 Preferred:
 Exposure to GTFS and GTFS-RT modeling
 Experience with Metro-specific data models and stop, route, and network data alignment
 Experience with data-driven cross-platform API models
 Experience with data mapping for Adobe/AEM, CRM, and downstream feeds
 Experience with .NET Core or Node.js on Azure
 Experience with data pipelines, ingestion, transformation, and data quality and governance
 Experience designing data structures for operational dashboards, analytics, archive and search functionality, and audit logging
 Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
 PeopleSoft certification
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
